reviews.text: Great build. The screws that come with are great, but will get the job down if you drill pilot holes if attaching to wood. reviews.text:
Shipped quick and arrived within expected shipping time. Product is great! The batteries fit smoothly inside it and stick out a bit so they can easily be grabbed and pulled out. I have it stuck underneath a shelf on my nearby bookshelf. And its perfect!
I highly recommend, about to buy another so I can keep track of more batteries of the same type. I chose the pink one, and its lovely!
